title: [IMP-31] Separate target PPAP creation from legacy generation
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-31

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-31

Title
Separate target PPAP creation from legacy generation

Category
Existing automation changes

Objective
Prevent old project-task/phase logic from running on the new target PPAP path.

Detailed scope
Change the verified legacy creation/generation handlers to preserve their historical/APQP branches and route marked target records into the supplied separate workflow and Draft initializer. Do not rebuild unchanged shared fields or downstream listeners made unreachable by these checks.

Deliverable
Narrow target branches on the named legacy handlers and a safe target-first creation connection.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.

What is waiting
Waiting: these shared-handler branches need the supported typed target lookup and creation order before they can be configured safely.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
This work changes several related records or decisions. A Senior Consultant should configure its order and recovery behavior because an incomplete update could change approval history or expose the wrong work.

Changes to the existing setup
Role Creation (e75c1108-299d-4ecf-83bd-0a91ea2b79be; /GraphData/Items/778)
The package writes the legacy template-role helper. Add an early target-only branch check before that write; target PPAP uses its governed specific-role fields and no legacy role generation. Preserve the original branch otherwise.

Set Phase Field & Task Creation (d5da1088-aa43-4014-857e-8c50a19e6857; /GraphData/Items/938)
The package initializes phase, follows stage and triggers shared project-task generation. Skip all three operations for Target Configuration?=TRUE before they run; preserve historical/APQP behavior and leave inherited counters/calculations unchanged.

Initialize PPAP When Task<>NULL (fc0d5679-5d86-4c11-b026-f76ff4d28eae; /GraphData/Items/845)
The package copies Product/Supplier/Customer/owner/date/legacy template from the task. For marked target creation bypass that legacy copy/generation branch. Create Target PPAP Draft supplies new values through its own assignment; this handler does not call it again. Do not infer authoritative manufacturing/drawing/part scope from old singular references.

Clear IMDS Field (6578b2b3-e10d-4ce5-b286-a003ba3606bd; /GraphData/Items/392)
The package clears the old IMDSOther value. Exclude target PPAP from that obsolete field behavior; preserve the original legacy branch.

Build instructions
1. Configure each proposed target branch by resolving the exact PPAP record and reading Target Configuration?, using the supplied native method; base handlers cannot simply assume a descendant field is accessible. Put the branch check before each named legacy write. Keep the default/historical marker FALSE.
2. Use the target marker as the condition that bypasses legacy generation. The Create Target PPAP Draft assignment alone owns writing the marker before creation/default processing and selecting the new workflow; do not add another initializer or call that creation operation again from the old handler.
3. Do not assign changes to legacy listeners already excluded by these early checks unless an actual remaining invocation path is supplied. Keep Copy Values on Create and Create PPAP unchanged: its package operation only fills DefId and does not establish a usable PPAP creation process.

How to check the result
• A marked target Draft does not generate old project checklist/tasks or alter legacy phase helpers.
• An unmarked historical/APQP record continues through the original handlers; the inherited task/phase definitions are not rebuilt.

Information needed for this task
IN-03: Supply supported typed descendant lookup, marker-before-handler order, target workflow selection and Id binding resolution.
IN-14: Supply the supported native branch expression/method for the exact legacy handlers below; no runtime subtype function is assumed.

Supplied input context
• IN-03 — Supported target workflow and shared-handler connection: The technical team must supply the supported way to select a new PPAP-only workflow for target records, read the PPAP-only Target Configuration? field from shared handlers, set it before legacy handlers run, and resolve the direct/inherited Id name collision. The plan assigns the resulting configuration changes, not a tenant-verification exercise.
• IN-14 — Target screens and supported expressions: The technical team must supply supported expressions and view-action methods where this design states business logic rather than executable Intelex syntax, together with the effective tenant view/module identifiers if they differ from the package. Build assignments use the verified package names and must not guess a replacement expression or tenant target.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
